questions.question: Which British English spelling is correct?
questions.explanation: Correct: centre. Standard British English places re at the end; center is the usual American form. The alternatives either use the wrong regional form or disturb the middle vowel pattern. Transfer: keep a personal list of British re words such as centre, metre and theatre.
